title: The Paperwork
subtitle: The one task that declines the default
description: Eight sheets of paper, and the house does not take them. This task
carries `consumeItems: false` explicitly, which is the exception a
chapter default exists to make visible: the ledger takes items
unless a task says otherwise, and this one says otherwise, because
nobody lends against paperwork they have confiscated.
A default nothing ever overrides is not a default. It is a rule
